body_html:
Introducing the newest addition to the JAMMIN’ DJs squad all the way from sunny Los Angeles, California – Skai, affectionately known as “The Captain”! Skai has been setting dance floors ablaze with his groovy beats since the electrifying year of 2008. With a degree in dance under his belt, he’s not only a DJ extraordinaire but also a seasoned professional emcee, making him the ultimate maestro of merriment.

When he’s not spinning tracks and working his magic on the mic, you can find Skai “The Captain” indulging in his passion for various interests. He’s a culinary connoisseur who loves whipping up delicious dishes, a basketball enthusiast who’s always up for a game, a semi-pro table tennis player who knows how to keep the competition fierce, and a crystal aficionado who enjoys the art of wire wrapping.

As for Skai’s favorite playgrounds, he thrives at the following types of gatherings: dance parties where he turns the music into pure energy, runway fashion shows where he creates the perfect musical backdrop for models to strut their stuff, and intimate gatherings where he crafts an atmosphere of unforgettable moments.

So, get ready to set sail on a musical voyage with “The Captain” himself, Skai, as he brings his charisma, beats, and boundless energy to a party near you!

What’s in Skai’s Headphones:  Westside Boogie, Saba, Bakar, Snoh Alegra, Summer Walker, fred again., and Peggy Gou
